settlement_source: CF Benchmarks CME CF Bitcoin Real Time Index (BRTI), https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/BRTI ; terms https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/BTC.pdf ; methodology v17.0 https://docs.cfbenchmarks.com/CME%20CF%20Real%20Time%20Indices%20Methodology.pdf ; constituents (v13.7): Bitstamp, Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini, LMAX Digital, Bullish, Crypto.com (itBit suspended 2026-07-27). Order-book index: exponentially-weighted mid price-volume curve to 0.5% depth, calc every 200 ms, disseminated ~1/s at 0.01 USD.
settlement_variable: Simple average of the 60 BRTI values in the minute immediately before T; YES iff average > floor_strike (strike X.99, strict). Revisions after expiration ignored. Unspecified: 1-s vs 200-ms sampling, [T-60,T) vs (T-60,T], <60 values.
timezone: Rules in US Eastern with EDT/EST label; API close_time UTC authoritative (21:00Z = 5 PM EDT). DST shift Nov 1 2026.
tie_handling: Strict > X.99; average exactly X.99 -> NO. Title '$X or above' vs rules '> X-0.01' differ for unrounded averages in (X-0.01, X).
rounding: Unspecified by Kalshi; BRTI to 0.01; average may carry more decimals; treat comparison as unrounded.
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time == T == end of averaging window: whole settlement window is inside live trading. Markets open 48 h before close; settlement_timer 60 s; observed settlement_ts ≈ close + 2m55s. Kalshi publishes only result (settlement_value null).
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early true (no condition). No data -> NO. Post-expiration revisions ignored. Market Outcome Review Rule 6.3(c); settlement delay Rule 7.1. Position accountability $25,000/strike/member. CF employees and MNPI holders barred.
title_vs_rules_divergences: '$76,000 or above' (inclusive) vs 'above 75999.99' (strict) differ for unrounded averages between
Title implies a spot price at an instant; rules use a 60-s trailing average of BRTI
Hour only in rules_primary/subtitle, not title
Data outage defaults to NO, not void
'60 prices collected in the last minute before expiration' while trading continues through that minute

toxicity_flags: Settlement window (T-60s..T) lies entirely inside live trading: anyone streaming the index can compute the running 60-s average; resting orders near the strike in the last minute are adversely selected
Settlement is a 60-s TWAP of an order-book index, not the spot/last-trade print; Coinbase/Binance tickers are proxies only
Kalshi does not publish the computed average for BTC (settlement_value null); rounding/boundary cases cannot be audited
Rounding/precision and window boundary (1-s vs 200-ms samples, inclusive/exclusive) unspecified
No data at expiration -> resolves NO (not void)
Kalshi Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3) and settlement delay (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion
CF Benchmarks is Kraken-owned (Payward); Kraken is a constituent; Expert Judgement permitted in extraordinary circumstances
Constituent set and methodology changed Jun-Sep 2026 (uncrossing, dynamic spacing, 200 ms effective time)
EDT/EST label changes with DST (Nov 1 2026); UTC close_time authoritative
Quadratic fee type and $100 strike ladder concentrate contracts near ATM where the ambiguities matter most
